A hypertonic solution has a higher solute concentration than the reference fluid, usually the inside of a cell, so water leaves the cell by osmosis and the cell shrinks. Neither option in the team note matches this: a solution with lower solute concentration than a normal cell is hypotonic, and blocking enteral tubes is not what defines hypertonic. The note's options look mistaken, so please check them against the source.

CONFIDENCE: 95
